criteria.criterion: Color and value: check for coherent blocks of chassis paint, dark mechanisms and a small visor accent against the playable lineup.
criteria.evidence: Olive paint joins the bridge, pod sides and hock armor. Buff stays on the cassette collars, cockpit brow and ankle guards. Dark trunnions carry the bodies and amber glazing stays visible below the brow.

criteria.criterion: Armor construction: broad facets and selective bevels describe the main volumes in the Mech Bay view.
criteria.evidence: Each elongated pod has a wide continuous flank paired with a beveled buff rim. The bridge descends in a separate broad plane between the pods. Shape changes carry the silhouette.

criteria.criterion: Detail scale: compare at Practice range size. The cockpit, stance and fitted weapon housings remain legible without fine texture.
criteria.evidence: At matched range size the two pod masses, small visible bridge glass, gap between the pods and rear-hock stance read together. Exact tube counts are clearer head-on.

criteria.criterion: Joints and interfaces: reinforced load-bearing pivots, protected waist connections and functional weapon attachments share the same industrial construction language.
criteria.evidence: Short double-supported trunnions attach the receivers directly to the bridge. The reverse-jointed limbs have exposed hocks and broad contact pads.

criteria.criterion: Distinct chassis identity: preserve the requested role, silhouette, cockpit, leg anatomy, proportions and legal mounts; do not copy another reference chassis or blend their equipment.
criteria.evidence: Two lateral carriers flank a low cockpit with no humanoid arms. The four dark wells in each selected A nose match the guided four-round fit and distinguish it from the long-nosed Kestrel and upright Maul.

gate: Selected by the assigned design agent on 2026-11-24. Individual owner review of this raster and integrated acceptance remain separate.
decisionAuthority: Assigned design agent acting under the owner’s delegated creative authority
visibleMountReview: Select the low Bulwark bridge between two olive receivers. Each broad buff nose has four cut-through octagonal mouths in a two-by-two matrix, on a carrier with two visible rearward hocks and three short forefoot pads per side.
